compareDisposition.rationale: No distinct two-source pairing adds more than this passage and its existing Scripture connections.

observations.body: Moses announces the contribution; men and women bring materials, skill, jewelry, fabric, spices, and stones as willing hearts move them.
observations.label: Willing hearts bring material for the dwelling

observations.body: Willing hearts bring material for the dwelling belongs to tablets and dwelling in the Sinai trail.
observations.label: Where this sits

observations.body: Exodus 35:4–29 supplies consequence evidence for the event’s developing sequence.
observations.label: What follows from Sinai

observations.body: The tablets and dwelling instructions develop the consequences of Sinai presence; they are not additional lines inside the Ten Words.
observations.label: Reading boundary

payload.posture: Read Exodus 35:4–29 as its own source before carrying it into the wider Sinai trail.
payload.tension: Willing hearts bring material for the dwelling follows from Sinai while remaining distinct from the words and actions at the mountain itself.
